name: Target Accuracy
description: Direct a ball or football towards a chosen target with controlled force and accuracy.

name: Ball Control
description: Control and manipulate a ball around the body using coordinated hand and body movements.

name: Balance
description: Maintain body control while stationary or moving through different positions.

name: Passing
description: Move the ball accurately to a teammate using an age-appropriate passing action.

name: Movement
description: Move efficiently in different directions using running, hopping, skipping and turning actions.

name: Catching
description: Track and receive a moving ball safely with controlled hands.

name: Coordination
description: Coordinate body movements and visual tracking to complete controlled movement tasks.
